resources.string: Watches the YouTube app for the "Skip Ad" button and taps it for you as soon as it appears. Reads screen content from YouTube only.
Service is ON. Skippable YouTube ads will be skipped automatically.
Service is OFF. Turn it on to start skipping ads.
Android does not let an app switch on its own accessibility service, so this last step is manual:\n\nSettings > Accessibility > Installed apps > Ad Skipper > On
Could not open Accessibility settings on this device. Open Settings and look for Accessibility > Installed apps > Ad Skipper.
